hero.title: BBS in Sweden for Indian Students
paras: A **Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS)** is an undergraduate degree for students interested in **business administration, marketing, finance, economics, entrepreneurship, and management**. Sweden offers several related bachelor's programmes for international students, including Indian students who want to develop business knowledge in an international academic environment.

highlights.title: World-Class Nordic Innovation
highlights.desc: Study in Sweden's globally ranked universities renowned for pioneering scientific breakthroughs, design thinking, and sustainable research.

highlights.title: English-Taught Degrees
highlights.desc: Over 1,000 bachelor's and master's degree programs delivered entirely in English with international accreditation.

highlights.title: Generous Post-Study Work
highlights.desc: Sweden offers residence permits after graduation for students to seek employment or start innovative businesses.

highlights.title: High Quality of Life
highlights.desc: Ranked among the top nations globally for safety, equality, environmental sustainability, and student well-being.

overview: However, the exact degree title **BBS** may not be available at every Swedish university. Similar undergraduate programmes are commonly offered under titles such as **Business and Economics, International Business, and International Management**.
Most comparable bachelor's programmes in Sweden take **three years (180 ECTS credits)** to complete. They can provide a foundation for postgraduate studies or careers in different business sectors.
Through **Edu Hawk worldwide** study abroad guidance, students can explore language-learning options and understand the eligibility, fees and application requirements.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for BBS in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, Indian students with qualifying credentials meeting English language proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) and academic prerequisites can apply to recognized universities in Sweden.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for BBS in Sweden?
items.a: Most master's and international bachelor's degree programmes are taught entirely in English for international students across Swedish universities.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for BBS in Sweden?
items.a: Tuition fees for international students generally range between SEK 80,000 and SEK 150,000 per year, depending on the institution and level of study.

items.q: Can international students work while studying in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, non-EU international students holding a valid Swedish residence permit for higher education are permitted to work alongside their studies without a fixed hours limitation during term time.
